events.title: 리버풀 remain top of the First Division on goal difference with a 4–1 win over 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road , which keeps the hosts at the bottom of the table. 애스턴 빌라 keep up the heat with a 2–1 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트, while 첼시's title bid is hit by a 5–2 home defeat to 윔블던.
아스널 draw level on points with 리버풀 at the top of the First Division when a Perry Groves goal gives them a 1–0 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드.
Andy Thorn moves from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for 크리스털 팰리스 for £650,000.
첼시 bolster their title challenge with a £300,000 move for 바이에른 뮌헨 and Norway defender Erland Johnsen . Howard Kendall is confirmed as the new 맨체스터 시티 manager.

아스널 go top of the First Division with a 1–0 win at 코번트리 시티, as 리버풀 and 애스턴 빌라 draw 1–1 at Anfield. 첼시's title hopes are further damaged when they lose 4–2 to QPR at Loftus Road . 맨체스터 유나이티드's disappointing league campaign continues with a 2–1 home defeat to 크리스털 팰리스.
Roy Wegerle , the American international striker, joins 퀸스 파크 레인저스 from 루턴 타운 for a club record £1million.

아스널 retain their lead of the First Division with a 3–2 home win over 루턴 타운, but 리버풀 keep up the pressure with a 5–2 win over 첼시 at Stamford Bridge . 애스턴 빌라's title hopes are hit by a 2–0 defeat at 밀월, who are now needing the points to stay clear of the relegation zone after topping the table in September. 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a third successive league defeat, going down 1–0 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼.
Italy's AC 밀란 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 , Japan by defeating Colombia 's Atlético 나시오날 in extra-time 1–0. The only goal is scored by Alberigo Evani .
18–year–old Trinidadian striker Dwight Yorke signs for 애스턴 빌라.
The last league action before Christmas sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 hold 리버풀 to a goalless draw at Anfield, ensuring that 아스널 remain a point ahead at the top of the table with a game in hand.

The Boxing Day action sees 리버풀 return to the top of the First Division with a 2–1 win over 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Anfield, as 아스널 lose 1–0 at 사우샘프턴. 애스턴 빌라 keep up the pressure with a 3–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Villa Park , a result which mounts the pressure on United manager 알렉스 퍼거슨 , whose team have picked up just two points from their last five games and are now 15th in the league. 노리치 시티's title hopes are hit by a 1–0 defeat at 맨체스터 시티, who climb off the bottom of the table. 찰턴 애슬레틱 now prop up the First Division, having lost 3–1 at 윔블던. In the Second Division, the leading pair of 리즈 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 draw 2–2 at Bramall Lane . 스윈던 타운 boost their promotion hopes with a 4–3 home win over promotion rivals 블랙번 로버스 at the County Ground .

웨스트햄 유나이티드 sign midfielder Ian Bishop and striker Trevor Morley from 맨체스터 시티 for £500,000 each. 밀월 attempt to arrest their dramatic fall down the First Division by playing a club record £800,000 for 더비 카운티 striker Paul Goddard .
리버풀 chairman John Smith receives a knighthood . Trevor Francis is offered a playing contract with 루턴 타운.

The last matches of the 1980s are played. 20-year-old striker Mark Robins scores his first goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a 2–2 draw at 윔블던, which rescues a point for 알렉스 퍼거슨's team but extend their winless run to six matches. 리버풀 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 1–0 at Anfield to boost their chances of reclaiming the league title from 아스널, who are leapfrogged into second place by 애스턴 빌라 after a 2–1 defeat at Villa Park . There is a six-goal thriller in a Second Division clash at Boundary Park , where 올덤 애슬레틱 and 포츠머스 draw 3–3.

The year and the decade ends with 리버풀 as First Division leaders by four points from 애스턴 빌라. 아스널 are a point further adrift. 찰턴 애슬레틱 prop up the table, behind 루턴 타운 and 셰필드 웬즈데이, while out–of–form 밀월 are outside the relegation zone only on goal difference. 리즈 유나이티드 are top of the Second Division with 셰필드 유나이티드 in second place. 선덜랜드, 올덤 애슬레틱, 입스위치 타운 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 occupy the play-off zone, while 웨스트햄 유나이티드's early challenge has fallen away and they now stand 11th in their first season outside the top flight for almost a decade.
